error.message: circuit test needs a reference: circuit test ID ref=NAME, where NAME is another run of this debugger (e.g. the opposite-answer prompt: `run name=NAME "..."` then `until logits`), or ref=set:NAME for the per-component mean over a prompt set. Zero-ablation is not offered: zeroing components is off-distribution, and on Qwen2.5-1.5B zeroing the complement moved the margin by 27.75 against a circuit effect of 1.81, so it said nothing (issue M4)
